# Change

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Link the relevant
issue or acceptance scenario when one exists.

## Validation

List the checks performed and their results. Separate static validation,
scenario reviews, and actual agent exercises. State anything not verified.

## Compatibility

Describe affected skills (`stacks`, `scaffold`), modes, references,
templates (under `skills/<name>/`), shared vocabularies or contracts between
the skills, or installation behavior. Write "None" when no compatibility change applies.
